items.title: Uber宣布裁員後 高層砸530萬美元買進自家股票
items.title_en: Uber Announces Layoffs, Senior Executive Spends $5.3 Million Buying Company Stock
paras: 《巴隆周刊》周二(8日)報導，在Uber Technologies(UBER-US)宣布自新冠疫情以來最大規模的裁員計畫幾天後，公司一名高階主管申報了他首次在公開市場買進公司股票。
根據美國證券管易委員會(SEC)一份申報文件，Uber營運長Andrew Macdonald 於9月4日買進7萬股Uber股票，總金額約530萬美元。
這些股票分兩筆交易購入，每股價格介於 75.23美元至76.85美元之間。
這次買進是Macdonald自2025年6月接任現職以來，首次在公開市場購買Uber股票。值得注意的是，這筆交易發生在Uber執行長Dara Khosrowshahi宣布裁員計畫僅數天後。Uber計劃裁減全球約10%的員工，目的是精簡中階管理層，並釋放更多資金投入策略性投資。
Khosrowshahi在9月2日寄給員工的電子郵件中表示，這次裁員將「讓Uber變得更簡單、更快速，並創造更多空間投資公司的未來。」這是Uber自疫情期間以來首次進行大規模縮編。疫情期間由於叫車需求大幅下滑，Uber曾裁減將近四分之一的員工。
此次裁員後，Uber的員工總數將降至略低於 3萬人，回到2021年的規模。這次重組正值Uber將資源重新配置至新的發展重點之際，其中包括未來幾年投入100億美元，以擴大公司的自動駕駛計程車(robo-taxi)業務。
Macdonald於2012年加入Uber，成為公司在多倫多的第一位總經理。他之後負責Uber的移動服務事業部，最終升任目前的營運長職位。
Uber股價周二下跌3.47%，至每股73.13美元。
paras_en: Baron Weekly reported on Tuesday (the 8th) that days after Uber Technologies (UBER-US) announced its largest layoff plan since the COVID‑19 pandemic, a senior executive filed a disclosure of his first purchase of company shares on the open market.

According to a filing with the U.S. Securities and Exchange Commission (SEC), Uber Chief Operating Officer Andrew Macdonald bought 70,000 Uber shares on September 4, for a total of about $5.3 million.
The shares were acquired in two separate transactions at prices ranging from $75.23 to $76.85 per share.

This purchase is Macdonald’s first open‑market acquisition of Uber stock since he assumed his current role in June 2025, and it came just days after CEO Dara Khosrowshahi announced the layoff plan. Uber plans to cut roughly 10% of its global workforce to streamline middle management and free up capital for strategic investments.

In an email to staff on September 2, Khosrowshahi said the cuts will “make Uber simpler, faster, and create more space to invest in the company’s future.” This is Uber’s first large‑scale downsizing since the pandemic, when a sharp drop in ride‑hailing demand led the company to cut nearly a quarter of its employees.

After the layoffs, Uber’s headcount will fall to just under 30,000, roughly the level of 2021. The restructuring comes as Uber reallocates resources to new priorities, including a planned $10 billion investment over the next few years to expand its robo‑taxi business.
Macdonald joined Uber in 2012 as the company’s first general manager in Toronto. He later oversaw Uber’s mobility services division before being promoted to his current COO position.
Uber’s stock fell 3.47% on Tuesday, closing at $73.13 per share.

items.title: 10年期美債殖利率升至5.5%將「攻擊」美股？法興警告：可能是估值臨界點
paras: 美國公債殖利率持續走高，市場對高利率環境可能對股票估值造成的壓力日益關注。法國興業銀行（Société Générale）全球資產配置主管Alain Bokobza警告，若10年期美國公債殖利率升至5.5%，企業獲利成長恐將不足以抵銷借貸成本上升對股市估值造成的衝擊。
Bokobza週一（7日）接受採訪時表示，今年全球企業獲利預期已大幅上修，使股票即使面對債券殖利率走高，風險溢價仍未出現明顯崩跌。
他指出，目前股票估值並未比年初更加昂貴。
不過，他認為企業獲利上修對股市估值的支撐並非沒有極限。當10年期美債殖利率升至5.5%時，獲利成長將難以繼續抵銷融資成本攀升的影響，股市屆時將開始承受壓力。
目前10年期美債殖利率報4.8%，美國因勞工節假日現貨市場休市。

油價、通膨與財政疑慮　推升美債殖利率

近期債券市場重新成為牽動股票投資人情緒的重要因素。
美伊衝突升溫帶動油價反彈，使通膨疑慮重新升高，加上聯準會（Fed）與歐洲央行釋出偏鷹派訊號、政府財政赤字疑慮，以及AI資本支出熱潮加劇資金競爭，共同推動美債殖利率上行。
Bokobza指出，今年全球企業獲利預期大幅上修，是股市在殖利率走高環境下仍能維持估值的重要支撐。
然而，這項緩衝機制並非無限，一旦殖利率突破5.5%，借貸成本上升對股票相對吸引力的壓制效果將更加明顯。
摩根大通策略師Grace Peters上週表示，10年期美債殖利率升至5%具有重要心理意義，可能引發股市出現劇烈反應；巴克萊策略師Emmanuel Cau也指出，若殖利率升至5%，投資人對股市前景的態度將大幅轉趨謹慎。

名目GDP結構性走高　成美債殖利率上行深層推力

Bokobza認為，本輪殖利率走高背後更深層的因素，在於名目GDP呈現「長期結構性上升」趨勢。
他指出，德國、日本等主要經濟體持續擴張財政，加上通膨維持高檔，以及AI基礎建設推動資本需求大幅增加，共同形成推升名目GDP的力量。
在他看來，這項變化可追溯至2020年代初期，代表經濟環境出現基礎性的典範轉移，目前仍未看到短期逆轉跡象。
因此，美債殖利率走高不只是貨幣政策變化的結果，也與更長期的經濟結構調整有關。

升息空間有限　Bokobza：經濟週期尚未結束

儘管市場對通膨持續性的疑慮升高，Bokobza認為，聯準會與歐洲央行後續升息幅度仍將相對有限，力道不足以中斷目前的經濟週期，也難以真正壓低通膨預期。
因此，在他的基本情境下，股市面臨的並非迫在眉睫的系統性崩盤風險，而是在高殖利率環境下逐步累積的壓力。
對投資人而言，10年期美債殖利率目前約4.8%，從4.78%至5.5%的區間，可能成為後續股債市場高度敏感的關鍵區域。

items.title: 〈貴金屬盤後〉油價上揚、CPI將發布 黃金收黑
items.title_en: Precious Metals After Hours: Oil Prices Rise, CPI to Be Released, Gold Closes Black
paras: 金價周二(8日)下跌，油價上揚加劇市場對通膨的疑慮，提高了聯準會(Fed)最快本月升息的機率，進而打壓不孳息的黃金。

黃金現貨下跌0.4%，報每盎司4385.09美元。
12月交割的黃金期貨收低1%，報每盎司4430.10美元。


StoneX資深市場策略師Daniel Pavilonis表示：「金價目前處於區間震盪，因升息機率提高形成上檔壓力，持續抑制市場動能。」
由伊朗支持的葉門青年運動(Houthis)攻擊沙烏地能源設施，加上德黑蘭威脅美國將發動「經濟戰」，推升油價，布蘭特原油一度逼近每桶100美元，最高觸及99.46美元，創7月24日以來新高，加劇市場對通膨的疑慮。
Zaner Metals副總裁兼資深金屬策略師Peter Grant表示，市場持續消化優於預期的美國就業報告，同時等待即將公布的CPI和PPI數據；油價上漲也加劇通膨疑慮，並支撐市場對9月升息的預期。
現貨金上周五一度重挫2.4%，此前數據顯示，美國8月就業成長大幅加速，而失業率維持在4.1%，進一步顯示勞動市場仍具韌性。
根據CME FedWatch工具，交易員目前押注央行在政策會議上升息的機率約為60%，高於數據公布前的約50%。
美國PPI將於周四公布，CPI數據則預計在周五發布。
儘管黃金通常被視為對抗通膨的避險資產，但利率上升往往會降低這項不孳息資產的吸引力。

其他貴金屬交易


現貨白銀上揚0.3%，報每盎司66.34美元。
現貨白金上揚0.8%，報每盎司1843.99美元。
現貨鈀金下跌2.5%，報每盎司1354.15美元。
paras_en: Gold prices fell on Tuesday (the 8th), as rising oil prices heightened market inflation concerns, increasing the probability of a Fed rate hike as early as this month, which in turn pressured non‑yielding gold.

Spot gold fell 0.4% to $4,385.09 per ounce. December gold futures closed down 1% at $4,430.10 per ounce. StoneX senior market strategist Daniel Pavilonis said: “Gold is currently range‑bound, and the higher probability of a rate hike is creating upside resistance, continuing to suppress market momentum.”

Iran‑backed Yemen’s Houthi movement attacked Saudi energy facilities, and Tehran threatened the United States with an “economic war,” pushing oil prices higher. Brent crude briefly approached $100 a barrel, peaking at $99.46, a new high since July 24, further stoking inflation worries.

Zaner Metals vice‑president and senior metal strategist Peter Grant said the market is still digesting a better‑than‑expected U.S. jobs report while awaiting the upcoming CPI and PPI data; the rise in oil prices also heightens inflation concerns and supports expectations of a September rate hike.

Spot gold on Friday last week plunged 2.4% after data showed U.S. August employment growth accelerated sharply, with the unemployment rate holding at 4.1%, further indicating a still‑resilient labor market.
According to the CME FedWatch tool, traders are currently betting about a 60% chance that the central bank will raise rates at its policy meeting, up from roughly 50% before the data release.
U.S. PPI is set to be released on Thursday, with CPI data expected on Friday.
Although gold is usually seen as an inflation‑hedging safe‑haven asset, rising rates tend to diminish the appeal of this non‑yielding asset.
Other precious metals: Spot silver rose 0.3% to $66.34 an ounce. Spot platinum gained 0.8% to $1,843.99 an ounce. Spot palladium fell 2.5% to $1,354.15 an ounce.

items.title: 市場押注Fed升息！花旗揭歷史贏家
items.title_en: Markets Bet on Fed Rate Hikes! Citi Unveils Historical Winners
paras: 《MarketWatch》報導，花旗策略師指出，聯準會 (Fed) 啟動升息循環後，美股初期表現通常較弱，日本與歐洲股市則往往相對占優。不過，美股隨後六至十二個月通常仍會上漲，花旗也持續看好全球股市至2027年中的上行空間。
由Beata Manthey領軍的策略團隊在週日發布的報告中指出，歷史經驗顯示，日本與英國股市在首次升息前後跑贏美股的比率，均略高於五成。
從平均相對報酬來看，日本約為3%，英國與澳洲接近2%，美股在升息後初期則接近負2%。
這些數據反映，升息循環啟動時，各國股市表現可能出現分歧。
類股方面，花旗發現，Fed升息後，全球景氣循環股平均表現優於防禦型股票。目前該行加碼配置金融、原物料與科技股，預期全球股市至年底仍有5%的上漲空間。
不過，對於這波升息何時到來，花旗與市場看法存在落差。根據FedWatch，市場目前反映的升息機率約為六成，花旗卻認為9月16日升息的可能性不高，預期Fed要到明年6月才會升息。
策略師表示，若Fed在9月16日收緊貨幣政策，市場對長天期公債殖利率攀升的疑慮可能進一步加深。
花旗也提醒，每一輪緊縮循環都有不同背景，不能單憑平均表現推論市場走向。不過，歷史經驗仍讓團隊有信心維持全球股市至2027年中進一步上漲的判斷。
paras_en: MarketWatch reports that Citi strategists note that after the Federal Reserve initiates a rate‑hike cycle, U.S. equities tend to underperform initially, while Japanese and European markets often hold the advantage. However, U.S. stocks typically rebound and rise over the following six to twelve months, and Citi remains bullish on global equities through mid‑2027.

The strategy team led by Beata Manthey released a report on Sunday showing that historically, Japanese and UK markets have outperformed U.S. stocks around the first rate hike, each by a margin of just over 50%.
Based on average relative returns, Japan posted about a 3% edge, the UK and Australia were close to 2%, while U.S. equities posted roughly –2% in the early post‑hike period.
These figures illustrate that when a rate‑hike cycle begins, equity performance can diverge across countries.

In terms of sectors, Citi found that after Fed hikes, global cyclical stocks have outperformed defensive stocks on average. The bank is now increasing exposure to financials, commodities and technology, expecting a further 5% rise in global equities by year‑end.

However, there is a gap between Citi’s view and the market on the timing of this hike. FedWatch shows the market currently assigns about a 60% probability to a hike, while Citi believes the likelihood of a September 16 hike is low and expects the Fed won’t raise rates until June next year.
Strategists say that if the Fed does tighten policy on September 16, market concerns about long‑term Treasury yields climbing could deepen further.

Citi also cautions that each tightening cycle has its own backdrop and one cannot infer market direction solely from average performance. Nonetheless, historical experience gives the team confidence to maintain its outlook for further global equity gains through mid‑2027.

items.title: 美軍發動新一輪攻擊 摧毀5艘伊朗油輪 布蘭特原油逼近100美元
items.title_en: U.S. Launches New Round of Attacks, Destroys Five Iranian Oil Tankers, Brent Crude Nears $100
paras: 多家外媒報導，伊朗近 3 日內兩度向美國海軍艦艇發射飛彈，美軍週二 (8 日) 因此對伊朗油輪發動新一輪攻擊。布蘭特原油價格週二一度突破每桶 99 美元，創下 7 月以來最高水準。
美國中央司令部  (CENTCOM) 週二 (8日) 發動新一波攻擊，摧毀五艘伊朗原油運油船，此舉是因伊斯蘭革命衛隊 (IRGC) 在過去兩天兩度以彈道飛彈鎖定美國海軍軍艦。美國軍艦成功規避伊朗的攻擊，並繼續在區域水域巡邏。無美國人員受傷。
美國官員表示，伊朗週末向一艘美國航空母艦及一艘神盾驅逐艦發射彈道飛彈。美軍隨後攻擊 3 艘伊朗油輪，稱這些船隻協助伊朗軍方及其代理組織取得資金，並藉此警告德黑蘭，美國不會容忍其攻擊海軍艦艇。
然而，美軍展開反擊一天後，伊朗週一再度向另一艘美國軍艦發射飛彈。美方隨即於週二對伊朗油輪發動新一輪攻擊，促使雙方軍事行動進一步升級。
伊朗兩波飛彈攻擊均未擊中美國軍艦，但顯示德黑蘭在美國封鎖其港口、經濟壓力升高之際，仍選擇加大攻勢。
伊朗伊斯蘭革命衛隊稱，至少有兩艘油輪遭到攻擊，伊朗矢言將對這次攻擊進行報復。
伊朗國營媒體並稱，當局已警告科威特及巴林港口附近的船舶人員撤離，暗示可能對當地商用船隻發動攻擊。
布蘭特原油價格週二一度突破每桶99美元，創下7月以來最高水平，隨後回落。目前價格較今夏低點上漲約35%。油價上漲預期對通膨的影響也推高了美債殖利率，對股市構成另一個挑戰。
半島電視台報導，美軍最近對伊朗油輪的襲擊目前尚未造成人員傷亡。
此外，伊媒引述官員說法宣稱，伊朗這次使用的是具備先進功能的新型飛彈。武器分析人士指出，相關飛彈可能配備光電尋標器，可利用影像辨識追蹤並飛向移動中的目標。
不過，要發動這類攻擊，伊朗仍須事先掌握美國軍艦的大致位置。美國官員因此擔憂，中國或俄羅斯可能正在協助伊朗追蹤美軍艦艇。今年 5 月，美國曾以在戰爭期間向伊朗提供衛星影像為由，制裁多個位於中國的實體，但美國總統川普迄今淡化中俄協助伊朗的疑慮。
paras_en: Multiple foreign media reported that Iran launched missiles at U.S. Navy vessels twice within three days, prompting the U.S. military to carry out a new round of attacks on Iranian oil tankers on Tuesday (the 8th). Brent crude prices briefly rose above $99 a barrel on Tuesday, the highest level since July.

U.S. Central Command (CENTCOM) launched a new wave of attacks on Tuesday (the 8th), destroying five Iranian crude‑oil tankers. The action was in response to the Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps (IRGC) having locked onto U.S. Navy ships with ballistic missiles twice over the past two days. U.S. warships successfully evaded the Iranian attacks and continued patrolling the regional waters. No U.S. personnel were injured.

U.S. officials said Iran fired ballistic missiles over the weekend at a U.S. aircraft carrier and a Aegis‑equipped destroyer. The U.S. subsequently struck three Iranian oil tankers, saying the vessels were helping the Iranian military and its proxies obtain funding and warning Tehran that the United States would not tolerate attacks on its naval vessels.

However, a day after the U.S. retaliation, Iran fired another missile at a different U.S. warship on Monday. The United States responded on Tuesday with a new round of attacks on Iranian oil tankers, further escalating the military actions between the two sides.
Both Iranian missile attacks missed the U.S. warships, but they show that Tehran is intensifying its offensive even as the United States tightens its port blockade and economic pressure on Iran.
The Islamic Revolutionary Guard Corps said at least two tankers were hit in the attacks and vowed that Iran would retaliate for this strike.
Iran’s state media also said authorities have warned vessels near ports in Kuwait and Bahrain to evacuate, hinting at possible attacks on commercial ships in those areas.

Brent crude prices briefly broke $99 a barrel on Tuesday, the highest level since July, before pulling back. The price is about 35% higher than the summer low. The rise in oil prices, and the inflation expectations it fuels, has also pushed up U.S. Treasury yields, posing another challenge to equity markets.
Al‑Jazeera reported that the recent U.S. attacks on Iranian oil tankers have so far caused no casualties.

In addition, Iranian media citing officials claimed the missiles used this time were a new, advanced type. Weapons analysts noted the missiles may be equipped with electro‑optical seekers that can use image recognition to track and home in on moving targets.

However, to launch such attacks Iran still needs to know the approximate location of U.S. warships in advance. U.S. officials therefore worry that China or Russia may be helping Iran track U.S. vessels. In May this year, the United States sanctioned several entities in China for providing satellite imagery to Iran during the war, but former President Trump has downplayed concerns about Chinese or Russian assistance to Iran.

items.title: 美光股價重返1000美元！9月底財報成關鍵、市場估EPS暴增近11倍
items.title_en: Micron Stock Back Above $1,000! Q3 Earnings at End‑September Key, Market EPS Estimates Surge Nearly 11‑Fold
paras: 記憶體晶片製造商美光科技(MU-US) 股價重新站回每股1000美元以上。外界預期該股股價，在本月底公布財報前，可能還有進一步上漲的空間。
根據《巴隆周刊》報導，美光週五（4日）股價上漲6.1%，收在1016.59美元，為8月17日以來首度收盤站上1000美元大關。由於美國勞工節假期，美股週一（7日）休市，美光也未進行交易。
不過，亞洲同業的股價走勢可能釋出正面訊號。週一，南韓記憶體晶片同行SK海力士(000660KS) 與三星電子(005930KS) 在韓國市場分別大漲8.3%和5.7%
下一個重大事件將是美光預計於9月30日發布的第4財季財報。根據FactSet數據，美光調整後每股純益（EPS）預計將從去年同期的2.84美元，大幅升至30.89美元；營收則預估將從113.2億美元增加至504.1億美元。
過去一年來，美光股價累計漲幅接近700%。
paras_en: Memory‑chip maker Micron Technology (MU‑US) has seen its share price climb back above $1,000 per share. Market participants expect the stock could rise further before the earnings report due at the end of the month.

According to Barron's, Micron’s shares jumped 6.1% on Friday (the 4th), closing at $1,016.59, marking the first time since August 17 that the stock closed above the $1,000 threshold. The U.S. stock market was closed on Monday (the 7th) for Labor Day, so Micron did not trade.

However, price moves among Asian peers may be sending a positive signal. On Monday, South Korean memory‑chip rivals SK Hynix (000660KS) and Samsung Electronics (005930KS) surged 8.3% and 5.7%, respectively, on the Korean market.

The next major event will be Micron’s Q4 fiscal‑year earnings, scheduled for September 30. FactSet data show adjusted earnings per share (EPS) are projected to jump from $2.84 a year ago to $30.89, while revenue is expected to rise from $11.32 billion to $50.41 billion.
Over the past year, Micron’s stock has accumulated a gain of nearly 700%.

items.title: 福特中國合作踩到川普紅線 寧德時代、吉利、比亞迪全被點名 美國運輸部警告國安風險
items.title_en: Ford's China Partnerships Cross Trump's Red Line; CATL, Geely, BYD All Named; US DOT Warns of National Security Risks
paras: 川普政府周二(8日)公開抨擊福特汽車(Ford Motor)(F-US)與多家中國企業的合作關係，認為相關交易涉及重大國家安全疑慮，並警告福特對中國電池技術及中國汽車製造商的依賴，可能讓中國企業進一步深入美國及西方汽車供應鏈。
美國運輸部長肖恩．達菲(Sean Duffy)周二致函福特執行長法利(Jim Farley)，指出福特與中國電池製造商寧德時代(CATL)(300750-CN)，以及中國汽車製造商吉利汽車(Geely)(0175-HK)、比亞迪(BYD)(002594-CN)的業務關係，都引發「深切關切」。福特截至目前尚未立即回應相關置評要求。
達菲表示，美國運輸部對福特在密西根州馬歇爾(Marshall)工廠依賴寧德時代授權技術「深感震驚」。福特正在當地推進電池製造布局，而與中國企業的技術合作也因此成為川普政府檢視美國汽車產業供應鏈安全的焦點。
達菲同時將矛頭指向福特與吉利汽車在西班牙的合資計畫。他認為，這項合作可能讓「戰略競爭對手」在西方市場取得重要立足點。福特與吉利今年7月宣布，雙方計畫在福特位於西班牙瓦倫西亞的工廠成立歐洲合資企業，預計在取得監管批准後於2027年上半年開始營運，並於2028年啟動新車生產。
根據雙方公布的規畫，吉利將持有新合資公司34%股權，福特持有66%，瓦倫西亞工廠潛在年產能約50萬輛。新合資企業將生產福特與吉利品牌的多能源車款，其中包括3款福特品牌多能源車，以及2款吉利品牌電動車，首批車輛預定2028年下線。
福特則表示，這項合作是為了因應歐洲汽車市場日益激烈的競爭、成本壓力及更嚴格的監管環境。雙方透過共享產能與開發成本，希望提高瓦倫西亞工廠的利用率、降低單車製造成本，並強化福特在歐洲市場的產品布局。
達菲另外指出，福特與比亞迪就油電混合車零組件進行的持續磋商，也可能讓「受到補貼的外國技術」進一步嵌入福特核心供應鏈。這項指控凸顯川普政府目前不僅關注中國製造的整車，也開始將中國企業提供的電池、零組件及相關技術視為供應鏈安全問題。
川普政府對福特的另一項主要批評，是福特計畫直到2030年才把林肯(Lincoln) Nautilus休旅車的生產從中國轉移至美國。達菲認為，在2030年前仍持續依賴中國製造，將形成一段「不可接受」的多年依賴期。
林肯Nautilus目前是福特旗下重要豪華休旅車款之一，福特此前已表示將把部分原本在中國生產、供應美國市場的車輛製造逐步轉回美國。達菲則認為，在美中競爭及供應鏈安全風險升高之際，轉移生產的時間表仍然過於緩慢。
這場爭議也凸顯福特在降低成本與維持全球競爭力方面所面臨的兩難。一方面，中國企業在電池、電動車及零組件領域具備成本與技術優勢，與其合作有助於福特降低製造成本並加速推出新產品；另一方面，美國政府正持續收緊對中國汽車、電池及相關科技的限制，使企業與中國合作的政治及資安成本快速升高。
事實上，福特與中國企業的合作並非近期才受到華府關注。今年2月，福特執行長法利曾與川普政府高層討論讓中國汽車製造商與美國企業成立合資企業的可能性，相關構想包括由美國企業持有控股權，以在引進中國製造及技術能力的同時降低對美國產業的衝擊。
與此同時，美國汽車業近期也加大限制中國汽車進入美國市場的遊說力度。代表通用汽車(GM-US)、福特、豐田、福斯、現代、本田及Stellantis等主要車廠的美國汽車創新聯盟(Alliance for Automotive Innovation)，本月3日敦促國會儘速通過相關法案，最晚在2026年底前永久禁止中國汽車進入美國市場。
該聯盟認為，中國政府補貼的汽車搭載聯網軟體與硬體，可能帶來國家安全風險，因此主張進一步限制比亞迪、奇瑞及上汽等中國車廠。相關法案雖已在參議院商務委員會取得進展，但仍面臨國會立法程序及產業界不同意見。
這也使福特目前的中國合作模式顯得格外敏感。美國政府一方面要求汽車製造商降低對中國供應鏈的依賴，另一方面福特仍需要借助中國企業的電池技術、零組件及製造能力來提升成本競爭力，尤其是在全球電動車市場競爭快速升溫的情況下。
福特的案例也反映出美中科技與產業競爭正從整車市場延伸至電池、零組件、軟體及製造技術。川普政府若進一步將中國技術供應視為國家安全問題，未來美國車廠與中國企業之間的授權、合資及零組件採購，都可能面臨更嚴格的審查。
對福特而言，如何在降低成本、維持全球市場競爭力與符合華府供應鏈政策之間取得平衡，將成為未來幾年的重大課題。尤其福特與吉利在西班牙的合資企業預計2027年開始營運、2028年投產，而福特與寧德時代的電池技術合作及中國製造車款也仍在調整之中，相關合作能否在美國政府日益嚴格的對中政策下持續推進，將受到市場密切關注。
paras_en: The Trump administration on Tuesday (the 8th) publicly attacked Ford Motor (F-US) for its collaborations with multiple Chinese firms, saying the deals raise serious national‑security concerns and warning that Ford's reliance on Chinese battery technology and Chinese automakers could let Chinese companies deepen their foothold in U.S. and Western auto supply chains.

U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy wrote to Ford CEO Jim Farley on Tuesday, stating that Ford's business ties with Chinese battery maker CATL (300750-CN) and Chinese automakers Geely (0175-HK) and BYD (002594-CN) have generated "deep concern." Ford has not yet responded to requests for comment.

Duffy said the Department of Transportation was "shocked" by Ford's dependence on CATL‑licensed technology at its Marshall, Michigan plant. Ford is pushing ahead with battery manufacturing at the site, and its technical cooperation with Chinese firms has become a focal point of the Trump administration's review of automotive supply‑chain security.

Duffy also singled out Ford's joint‑venture plan with Geely in Spain, arguing the partnership could give a "strategic competitor" a significant foothold in Western markets. Ford and Geely announced in July that they intend to set up a European JV at Ford's Valencia plant, slated to begin operations in the first half of 2027 after regulatory approval and to start vehicle production in 2028.

According to the disclosed plan, Geely will hold 34% of the new JV and Ford 66%, with the Valencia facility capable of producing about 500,000 vehicles a year. The JV will build multi‑energy models under both the Ford and Geely brands, including three Ford multi‑energy vehicles and two Geely electric cars, with the first batch slated for delivery in 2028.

Ford said the collaboration is meant to meet the intensifying competition, cost pressures and tighter regulatory environment in the European auto market. By sharing capacity and development costs, the two aim to boost utilization of the Valencia plant, lower per‑vehicle manufacturing costs and strengthen Ford's product footprint in Europe.

Duffy also noted that ongoing talks between Ford and BYD on hybrid‑vehicle components could embed "subsidized foreign technology" deeper into Ford's core supply chain. The allegation highlights that the Trump administration is now looking beyond complete Chinese‑made cars to battery, component and technology supplies as security issues.

Another major criticism from the Trump administration is Ford's plan to keep producing the Lincoln Nautilus SUV in China until 2030 before shifting it to the United States. Duffy called the continued reliance on Chinese manufacturing through 2030 an "unacceptable" multi‑year dependency.

The Lincoln Nautilus is one of Ford's key luxury SUVs, and the company has previously said it will gradually move some China‑produced models that supply the U.S. market back to domestic factories. Duffy argues that, given rising U.S.–China rivalry and supply‑chain security risks, the timeline for relocation remains too slow.

The dispute underscores the dilemma Ford faces between cutting costs and staying globally competitive. On one hand, Chinese firms offer cost and technology advantages in batteries, EVs and components, helping Ford lower manufacturing costs and accelerate new‑product rollouts; on the other, the U.S. government is tightening restrictions on Chinese automotive, battery and related technologies, driving up political and cyber‑security costs of such partnerships.

In fact, Ford's cooperation with Chinese firms has been on Washington's radar for some time. In February, CEO Jim Farley discussed with senior Trump officials the possibility of joint ventures between Chinese automakers and U.S. companies, including concepts where U.S. firms would hold controlling stakes to mitigate the impact of importing Chinese manufacturing and technology capabilities.

Meanwhile, the U.S. auto industry has stepped up lobbying to curb Chinese cars entering the U.S. market. The Alliance for Automotive Innovation, representing GM, Ford, Toyota, Volkswagen, Hyundai, Honda and Stellantis, urged Congress on the 3rd of this month to pass legislation that would permanently ban Chinese automobiles from the United States by the end of 2026.

The alliance argues that Chinese‑subsidized cars equipped with connected software and hardware could pose national‑security risks, and therefore calls for tighter restrictions on BYD, Chery and SAIC. Although the bill has made progress in the Senate Commerce Committee, it still faces the full legislative process and industry dissent.

This makes Ford's current China cooperation model especially sensitive. The U.S. government wants automakers to reduce reliance on Chinese supply chains, yet Ford still needs Chinese battery technology, components and manufacturing capacity to stay cost‑competitive, especially as the global EV market heats up rapidly.

Ford's case illustrates how U.S.–China tech and industry competition is spilling from the whole‑vehicle market into batteries, components, software and manufacturing techniques. If the Trump administration further treats Chinese technology as a national‑security issue, future licensing, joint‑venture and component‑sourcing deals between U.S. automakers and Chinese firms could face stricter scrutiny.

For Ford, balancing cost reduction, global competitiveness and compliance with Washington's supply‑chain policies will be a major challenge in the coming years. The planned Geely‑Ford JV in Spain is expected to start operating in 2027 and begin production in 2028, while its battery‑tech tie‑up with CATL and China‑made models remain in flux; whether these collaborations can continue under an increasingly stringent U.S. China policy will be watched closely by the market.

items.title: Meta AI再進化！Muse正式上線 可跨App替用戶辦事 寄信、購物付款、賣車、訂機票
items.title_en: Meta AI Evolves Again! Muse Officially Launched, Can Operate Across Apps for Users – Sending Emails, Shopping Payments, Car Sales, Flight Booking
paras: Meta(META-US)周二(8日)正式推出備受期待的AI代理Muse，可代表使用者自主執行寄送電子郵件、出售汽車及預訂旅程等任務。這項產品是Meta執行長祖克柏(Mark Zuckerberg)推動「個人超級智慧」(personal superintelligence)願景的核心產品，但公司內部測試近期仍出現連線中斷、未經授權上傳敏感資料等問題，引發外界對AI代理存取個人資料安全性的疑慮。
Meta表示，Muse初期僅在美國推出，使用者可透過專用Muse App或Meta旗下WhatsApp使用這項服務。Meta並計畫「很快」將Muse加入旗下智慧眼鏡產品，但尚未公布具體時間表。
Muse原型是基於開源AI代理OpenClaw打造，設計目標是讓AI代理跨越不同類型的應用程式執行任務，包括電子郵件、行事曆、支付、健康、購物及智慧家庭等。使用者可以自行選擇允許Muse連接哪些App，也能隨時撤銷相關存取權限。
與一般聊天型AI不同，Muse代理會在獨立的虛擬機器中運作。這是一種以雲端技術模擬個人電腦環境的架構，即使使用者當下沒有開啟Muse，AI代理仍能在背景持續執行使用者交辦的任務。
Muse能夠直接連接包含使用者真實資料的應用程式，使AI代理的實用性大幅提高，但同時也讓安全性、可靠性及隱私問題的重要程度同步升高。一旦AI代理判斷錯誤或執行任務時出現偏差，不僅可能影響授權使用者，也可能波及與使用者互動的其他人。
Meta AI產品副總裁Vishal Shah表示，公司原本計畫在4月推出Muse，但當時決定延後發布，以進一步提高產品安全性。Meta在經過額外開發後認為，相關工作已讓Muse「跨過門檻」，達到公司對產品安全、資安、隱私、模型效能及其他指標設定的最低要求。
Shah接受訪問時表示，不可能保證AI代理永遠不會犯錯，但Muse的每一個架構環節都經過設計，目標是在可行範圍內讓系統更加安全、可靠及保護隱私。
然而，Meta內部員工截至本周仍對Muse的實際表現評價不一。路透取得的Meta內部測試貼文顯示，一些員工高度肯定Muse在規劃假期方面的實用性，但也有人回報產品無預警斷線，以及未經允許上傳敏感資料等問題。
其中一名員工表示，Muse在安排旅遊行程及地面交通方面非常實用，以至於近期在印尼進行為期3周的蜜月旅行時，Muse幾乎成為「第三名參與者」。
但另一名測試員則表示，在要求Muse持續監控容易售罄的票券及其他商品時，遇到「許多讓產品變得不可靠的失效模式」。該員工指出，Muse運作約15分鐘後便停止重新整理頁面，對其他錯誤也沒有提供明確提示，有時甚至會在「沒有明顯原因」的情況下停止監控。
Meta技術長Andrew Bosworth也在內部貼文中表示，他經常遭到系統登出，必須重新登入，有時甚至在幾分鐘內就得重複登入數次。
內部測試也暴露出更嚴重的資安風險。部分員工發現，AI代理可能繞過原本設置的防護機制，在使用者要求Muse從兒童生日派對照片中辨識玩具時，進一步存取並曝光個人的iCloud照片。
這類問題凸顯AI代理與一般生成式AI服務之間的重大差異。當AI只能回答問題或產生文字時，錯誤通常局限於內容本身；但當AI代理取得電子郵件、照片、支付工具、健康資訊或智慧家庭等實際應用程式的權限後，一旦出現錯誤判斷，就可能直接代表使用者採取行動，甚至造成資料外洩或財務及隱私風險。
Meta目前讓使用者自行決定Muse可以連接哪些應用程式，並提供隨時撤銷權限的機制。公司也透過獨立虛擬機器讓每個Muse代理在隔離的雲端環境中運作，希望降低AI代理直接影響使用者裝置及資料的風險。
不過，Meta尚未立即回應路透針對內部員工所描述具體問題的詢問。隨著Meta逐步讓Muse接觸更多真實世界應用程式，產品能否在便利性與安全性之間取得平衡，將成為其推動「個人超級智慧」策略能否落地的關鍵。
對Meta而言，Muse不只是另一款AI聊天工具，而是公司試圖讓AI從「回答問題」進一步轉向「替使用者完成工作」的重要嘗試。若AI代理能可靠地處理電子郵件、行程、購物、付款及其他日常任務，可能大幅改變人們與App及網路服務互動的方式；但內部測試所揭露的錯誤及資安漏洞，也顯示這類技術在大規模普及前仍面臨相當高的安全與可靠性門檻。
paras_en: Meta (META-US) on Tuesday (the 8th) officially rolled out the highly anticipated AI agent Muse, which can autonomously handle tasks such as sending emails, selling cars and booking travel on behalf of users. The product is a core component of CEO Mark Zuckerberg’s vision of “personal superintelligence,” but internal testing has recently revealed issues like connection drops and unauthorized uploading of sensitive data, raising concerns about the safety of AI agents accessing personal information.

Meta said Muse is initially available only in the United States, and users can access the service via a dedicated Muse app or through Meta’s WhatsApp. The company also plans to add Muse to its smart‑glasses lineup “soon,” though no specific timeline has been disclosed.

Muse’s prototype is built on the open‑source AI agent OpenClaw and is designed to let an AI agent operate across different types of applications, including email, calendar, payments, health, shopping and smart‑home services. Users can choose which apps to allow Muse to connect to and can revoke those permissions at any time.

Unlike typical chat‑type AIs, the Muse agent runs in an isolated virtual machine. This cloud‑based architecture simulates a personal computer environment, so even when the user does not have Muse open, the AI can continue executing assigned tasks in the background.

Muse can connect directly to applications that contain the user’s real data, dramatically increasing its usefulness, but also raising the stakes for security, reliability and privacy. If the agent makes a mistake or deviates from the intended task, it could affect not only the authorized user but also others who interact with that user.

Meta AI product vice‑president Vishal Shah said the company originally planned to launch Muse in April but postponed the release to further improve safety. After additional development, Meta believes the work has pushed Muse past the threshold to meet the company’s minimum standards for product safety, cybersecurity, privacy, model performance and other metrics.

Shah told reporters that it is impossible to guarantee an AI agent will never err, but every component of Muse’s architecture has been designed to make the system as safe, reliable and privacy‑protective as possible within feasible limits.

However, internal staff evaluations of Muse’s performance remain mixed as of this week. Reuters obtained internal test posts showing some employees highly praising Muse’s usefulness for vacation planning, while others reported unannounced disconnections and unauthorized uploads of sensitive data.

One employee said Muse was extremely helpful for arranging travel itineraries and ground transportation, to the point that during a three‑week honeymoon in Indonesia it was almost a “third participant.”

Another tester reported that when asking Muse to continuously monitor tickets and other items that sell out quickly, they encountered “many failure modes that make the product unreliable.” The employee noted that after about 15 minutes Muse stopped refreshing pages, gave no clear error messages, and sometimes halted monitoring for “no apparent reason.”
Meta’s chief technology officer Andrew Bosworth also posted internally that he is frequently logged out by the system and has to sign back in, sometimes multiple times within a few minutes.

Internal testing also uncovered more serious cybersecurity risks. Some staff found that the AI agent could bypass existing safeguards; when a user asked Muse to identify toys in a child’s birthday‑party photos, the agent went on to access and expose the person’s iCloud photo library.

These issues highlight a major difference between AI agents and ordinary generative AI services. When an AI only answers questions or generates text, errors are usually limited to the content itself; but once an agent gains access to email, photos, payment tools, health data or smart‑home apps, a misjudgment can lead the AI to act on the user’s behalf, potentially causing data leaks or financial and privacy harms.

Meta currently lets users decide which apps Muse can connect to and provides a mechanism to revoke permissions at any time. The company also runs each Muse agent in an isolated cloud environment via separate virtual machines, aiming to reduce the risk of the agent directly affecting the user’s device or data.

Meta has not yet responded to Reuters’ inquiries about the specific problems described by internal employees. As Muse gradually gains access to more real‑world applications, whether the product can balance convenience with safety will be crucial to the success of Meta’s “personal superintelligence” strategy.

For Meta, Muse is more than another AI chat tool; it is a key attempt to shift AI from merely “answering questions” to “doing work for users.” If AI agents can reliably handle email, scheduling, shopping, payments and other daily tasks, they could fundamentally change how people interact with apps and online services, but the errors and security flaws uncovered in internal testing show that the technology still faces high barriers to safety and reliability before wide‑scale adoption.

items.title: 福特中國合作踩到川普紅線 寧德時代、吉利、比亞迪全被點名 美國運輸部警告國安風險
items.title_en: Ford's China Partnerships Cross Trump's Red Line; CATL, Geely, BYD All Named; US DOT Warns of National Security Risks
paras: 川普政府周二(8日)公開抨擊福特汽車(Ford Motor)(F-US)與多家中國企業的合作關係，認為相關交易涉及重大國家安全疑慮，並警告福特對中國電池技術及中國汽車製造商的依賴，可能讓中國企業進一步深入美國及西方汽車供應鏈。
美國運輸部長肖恩．達菲(Sean Duffy)周二致函福特執行長法利(Jim Farley)，指出福特與中國電池製造商寧德時代(CATL)(300750-CN)，以及中國汽車製造商吉利汽車(Geely)(0175-HK)、比亞迪(BYD)(002594-CN)的業務關係，都引發「深切關切」。福特截至目前尚未立即回應相關置評要求。
達菲表示，美國運輸部對福特在密西根州馬歇爾(Marshall)工廠依賴寧德時代授權技術「深感震驚」。福特正在當地推進電池製造布局，而與中國企業的技術合作也因此成為川普政府檢視美國汽車產業供應鏈安全的焦點。
達菲同時將矛頭指向福特與吉利汽車在西班牙的合資計畫。他認為，這項合作可能讓「戰略競爭對手」在西方市場取得重要立足點。福特與吉利今年7月宣布，雙方計畫在福特位於西班牙瓦倫西亞的工廠成立歐洲合資企業，預計在取得監管批准後於2027年上半年開始營運，並於2028年啟動新車生產。
根據雙方公布的規畫，吉利將持有新合資公司34%股權，福特持有66%，瓦倫西亞工廠潛在年產能約50萬輛。新合資企業將生產福特與吉利品牌的多能源車款，其中包括3款福特品牌多能源車，以及2款吉利品牌電動車，首批車輛預定2028年下線。
福特則表示，這項合作是為了因應歐洲汽車市場日益激烈的競爭、成本壓力及更嚴格的監管環境。雙方透過共享產能與開發成本，希望提高瓦倫西亞工廠的利用率、降低單車製造成本，並強化福特在歐洲市場的產品布局。
達菲另外指出，福特與比亞迪就油電混合車零組件進行的持續磋商，也可能讓「受到補貼的外國技術」進一步嵌入福特核心供應鏈。這項指控凸顯川普政府目前不僅關注中國製造的整車，也開始將中國企業提供的電池、零組件及相關技術視為供應鏈安全問題。
川普政府對福特的另一項主要批評，是福特計畫直到2030年才把林肯(Lincoln) Nautilus休旅車的生產從中國轉移至美國。達菲認為，在2030年前仍持續依賴中國製造，將形成一段「不可接受」的多年依賴期。
林肯Nautilus目前是福特旗下重要豪華休旅車款之一，福特此前已表示將把部分原本在中國生產、供應美國市場的車輛製造逐步轉回美國。達菲則認為，在美中競爭及供應鏈安全風險升高之際，轉移生產的時間表仍然過於緩慢。
這場爭議也凸顯福特在降低成本與維持全球競爭力方面所面臨的兩難。一方面，中國企業在電池、電動車及零組件領域具備成本與技術優勢，與其合作有助於福特降低製造成本並加速推出新產品；另一方面，美國政府正持續收緊對中國汽車、電池及相關科技的限制，使企業與中國合作的政治及資安成本快速升高。
事實上，福特與中國企業的合作並非近期才受到華府關注。今年2月，福特執行長法利曾與川普政府高層討論讓中國汽車製造商與美國企業成立合資企業的可能性，相關構想包括由美國企業持有控股權，以在引進中國製造及技術能力的同時降低對美國產業的衝擊。
與此同時，美國汽車業近期也加大限制中國汽車進入美國市場的遊說力度。代表通用汽車(GM-US)、福特、豐田、福斯、現代、本田及Stellantis等主要車廠的美國汽車創新聯盟(Alliance for Automotive Innovation)，本月3日敦促國會儘速通過相關法案，最晚在2026年底前永久禁止中國汽車進入美國市場。
該聯盟認為，中國政府補貼的汽車搭載聯網軟體與硬體，可能帶來國家安全風險，因此主張進一步限制比亞迪、奇瑞及上汽等中國車廠。相關法案雖已在參議院商務委員會取得進展，但仍面臨國會立法程序及產業界不同意見。
這也使福特目前的中國合作模式顯得格外敏感。美國政府一方面要求汽車製造商降低對中國供應鏈的依賴，另一方面福特仍需要借助中國企業的電池技術、零組件及製造能力來提升成本競爭力，尤其是在全球電動車市場競爭快速升溫的情況下。
福特的案例也反映出美中科技與產業競爭正從整車市場延伸至電池、零組件、軟體及製造技術。川普政府若進一步將中國技術供應視為國家安全問題，未來美國車廠與中國企業之間的授權、合資及零組件採購，都可能面臨更嚴格的審查。
對福特而言，如何在降低成本、維持全球市場競爭力與符合華府供應鏈政策之間取得平衡，將成為未來幾年的重大課題。尤其福特與吉利在西班牙的合資企業預計2027年開始營運、2028年投產，而福特與寧德時代的電池技術合作及中國製造車款也仍在調整之中，相關合作能否在美國政府日益嚴格的對中政策下持續推進，將受到市場密切關注。
paras_en: The Trump administration on Tuesday (the 8th) publicly attacked Ford Motor (F-US) for its collaborations with multiple Chinese firms, saying the deals raise serious national‑security concerns and warning that Ford's reliance on Chinese battery technology and Chinese automakers could let Chinese companies deepen their foothold in U.S. and Western auto supply chains.

U.S. Transportation Secretary Sean Duffy wrote to Ford CEO Jim Farley on Tuesday, stating that Ford's business ties with Chinese battery maker CATL (300750-CN) and Chinese automakers Geely (0175-HK) and BYD (002594-CN) have generated "deep concern." Ford has not yet responded to requests for comment.

Duffy said the Department of Transportation was "shocked" by Ford's dependence on CATL‑licensed technology at its Marshall, Michigan plant. Ford is pushing ahead with battery manufacturing at the site, and its technical cooperation with Chinese firms has become a focal point of the Trump administration's review of automotive supply‑chain security.

Duffy also singled out Ford's joint‑venture plan with Geely in Spain, arguing the partnership could give a "strategic competitor" a significant foothold in Western markets. Ford and Geely announced in July that they intend to set up a European JV at Ford's Valencia plant, slated to begin operations in the first half of 2027 after regulatory approval and to start vehicle production in 2028.

According to the disclosed plan, Geely will hold 34% of the new JV and Ford 66%, with the Valencia facility capable of producing about 500,000 vehicles a year. The JV will build multi‑energy models under both the Ford and Geely brands, including three Ford multi‑energy vehicles and two Geely electric cars, with the first batch slated for delivery in 2028.

Ford said the collaboration is meant to meet the intensifying competition, cost pressures and tighter regulatory environment in the European auto market. By sharing capacity and development costs, the two aim to boost utilization of the Valencia plant, lower per‑vehicle manufacturing costs and strengthen Ford's product footprint in Europe.

Duffy also noted that ongoing talks between Ford and BYD on hybrid‑vehicle components could embed "subsidized foreign technology" deeper into Ford's core supply chain. The allegation highlights that the Trump administration is now looking beyond complete Chinese‑made cars to battery, component and technology supplies as security issues.

Another major criticism from the Trump administration is Ford's plan to keep producing the Lincoln Nautilus SUV in China until 2030 before shifting it to the United States. Duffy called the continued reliance on Chinese manufacturing through 2030 an "unacceptable" multi‑year dependency.

The Lincoln Nautilus is one of Ford's key luxury SUVs, and the company has previously said it will gradually move some China‑produced models that supply the U.S. market back to domestic factories. Duffy argues that, given rising U.S.–China rivalry and supply‑chain security risks, the timeline for relocation remains too slow.

The dispute underscores the dilemma Ford faces between cutting costs and staying globally competitive. On one hand, Chinese firms offer cost and technology advantages in batteries, EVs and components, helping Ford lower manufacturing costs and accelerate new‑product rollouts; on the other, the U.S. government is tightening restrictions on Chinese automotive, battery and related technologies, driving up political and cyber‑security costs of such partnerships.

In fact, Ford's cooperation with Chinese firms has been on Washington's radar for some time. In February, CEO Jim Farley discussed with senior Trump officials the possibility of joint ventures between Chinese automakers and U.S. companies, including concepts where U.S. firms would hold controlling stakes to mitigate the impact of importing Chinese manufacturing and technology capabilities.

Meanwhile, the U.S. auto industry has stepped up lobbying to curb Chinese cars entering the U.S. market. The Alliance for Automotive Innovation, representing GM, Ford, Toyota, Volkswagen, Hyundai, Honda and Stellantis, urged Congress on the 3rd of this month to pass legislation that would permanently ban Chinese automobiles from the United States by the end of 2026.

The alliance argues that Chinese‑subsidized cars equipped with connected software and hardware could pose national‑security risks, and therefore calls for tighter restrictions on BYD, Chery and SAIC. Although the bill has made progress in the Senate Commerce Committee, it still faces the full legislative process and industry dissent.

This makes Ford's current China cooperation model especially sensitive. The U.S. government wants automakers to reduce reliance on Chinese supply chains, yet Ford still needs Chinese battery technology, components and manufacturing capacity to stay cost‑competitive, especially as the global EV market heats up rapidly.

Ford's case illustrates how U.S.–China tech and industry competition is spilling from the whole‑vehicle market into batteries, components, software and manufacturing techniques. If the Trump administration further treats Chinese technology as a national‑security issue, future licensing, joint‑venture and component‑sourcing deals between U.S. automakers and Chinese firms could face stricter scrutiny.

For Ford, balancing cost reduction, global competitiveness and compliance with Washington's supply‑chain policies will be a major challenge in the coming years. The planned Geely‑Ford JV in Spain is expected to start operating in 2027 and begin production in 2028, while its battery‑tech tie‑up with CATL and China‑made models remain in flux; whether these collaborations can continue under an increasingly stringent U.S. China policy will be watched closely by the market.

items.title: 〈能源盤後〉胡塞組織突襲沙國能源設施 油價飆至6周高點 Brent逼近98美元
items.title_en: Energy After-Hours: Houthi Group Attacks Saudi Energy Facilities, Oil Prices Surge to Six-Week High as Brent Nears $98
paras: 受中東能源設施遇襲及戰事擴大風險推動，國際油價周二(8日)攀抵近6周高點。伊朗支持的胡塞組織(Houthis)攻擊沙烏地阿拉伯多座城市及能源設施，引發石油設施起火，也加深市場對中東戰事可能進一步擴大、並衝擊全球能源供應的擔憂。
布蘭特(Brent)原油期貨上漲92美分或0.9%，收在每桶97.92美元，連續第2個交易日創下7月23日以來最高收盤價；美國西德州中級原油(WTI)期貨上漲1.55美元或1.7%，收在每桶93.03美元，創下6月4日以來最高收盤價。兩大原油基準目前均處於技術面超買區域。
胡塞組織周二襲擊沙烏地阿拉伯南部4座城市。沙國是美國重要盟友，這波攻擊造成超過70人受傷，並導致石油設施起火。胡塞組織控制的媒體稍後報導，沙烏地戰機對葉門首都沙那以東的朱巴(Jubah)地區，以及西南部塔伊茲省(Taiz)發動空襲。
中東能源供應自2月底美國與以色列聯合打擊伊朗後便持續受到嚴重干擾。伊朗隨後攻擊區域能源基礎設施及通過荷姆茲海峽的船隻，使波斯灣地區的石油出口受到重大影響。
沙烏地阿拉伯是全球第2大原油生產國，僅次於美國。由於荷姆茲海峽運輸受到阻礙，沙國一直透過將原油運往紅海、再經由其他航線出口，以降低對荷姆茲海峽的依賴。然而，周二的攻擊似乎是近期針對沙烏地阿拉伯規模最大的襲擊之一，市場擔心戰事若進一步擴大，可能不再局限於荷姆茲海峽，而是直接威脅中東其他能源供應設施，進一步放大全球經濟衝擊。
華爾街目前也開始面對中東航運與能源供應中斷可能延續至2027年的風險。高盛、匯豐等銀行近期已上調2026年剩餘時間及2027年的原油價格預測，反映市場對中東能源供應緊張局勢持續時間拉長的擔憂。
根據航運數據公司Kpler周二公布的數據，周一通過荷姆茲海峽的商品運輸船數量降至7艘，低於前一天的8艘。美國與以色列在2月底攻擊伊朗之前，全球約20%的石油供應會經由荷姆茲海峽運輸，這也凸顯目前航運受阻對全球能源市場的重要性。
不過，油價周二盤中漲幅一度更大，之後受到通膨及利率風險升高的影響而回吐部分漲幅。投資人擔心燃料成本持續攀升將推高全球通膨，迫使各國央行維持甚至提高利率，進而壓抑經濟成長及能源需求。
全球燃料價格近期大幅上漲，主要受到中東、俄羅斯及其他地區煉油廠供應中斷影響。美國柴油價格上周升至歷史新高，美國民眾在勞動節假期周末也面臨創紀錄的汽油價格。
多名能源業界高層預期，由於全球剩餘煉油產能有限，加上俄羅斯在烏克蘭持續攻擊其能源設施後禁止燃料出口，以及北半球冬季需求高峰即將到來，全球柴油供應緊張情況可能持續整個冬季。
燃料價格走高，加上美國聯準會理事克里斯多福．沃勒(Christopher Waller)的談話，以及強於預期的美國就業報告，已促使部分投資人重新調整對美國利率政策的預期。根據CME FedWatch Tool，交易員目前預估聯準會在9月15日至16日政策會議升息的機率約為60%，高於就業數據公布前的約50%。
俄羅斯與烏克蘭戰事的發展也牽動油價走勢。美國總統川普周二與俄羅斯總統普丁通電話時表示，希望俄烏戰爭能迅速結束，以便全面恢復美俄關係。克里姆林宮表示，普丁支持川普的這項看法。
如果俄烏戰爭結束，俄羅斯能源出口可能增加，進而對國際油價形成壓力。根據美國能源數據，俄羅斯在2025年是全球第3大原油生產國，排名僅次於美國與沙烏地阿拉伯，同時也是石油輸出國組織與盟友(OPEC+)的重要成員。
亞洲需求方面，中國海關周二公布的數據顯示，中國8月原油進口量較7月改善，但仍較去年同期下降23.4%。中國是全球第2大經濟體，僅次於美國。中國自3月起限制成品油出口，以保障國內供應，即使國內消費因燃料價格上漲而下滑，出口限制政策仍持續實施。
市場目前正同時面臨中東能源供應風險、全球煉油能力不足、俄羅斯能源出口變數，以及中國原油需求放緩等多重因素。若中東戰事進一步蔓延至沙烏地阿拉伯等主要能源生產國，油價可能持續受到供應中斷風險支撐；但高油價對通膨、利率與全球經濟成長的反作用，也可能限制原油需求並壓抑油價進一步上漲空間。
paras_en: The international oil market rose to a near six‑week high on Tuesday (the 8th) as the risk of attacks on Middle‑East energy facilities and an expanding war drove prices up. Iran‑backed Houthi forces struck several Saudi Arabian cities and energy sites, causing fires at oil installations and deepening market concerns that the conflict could widen further and hit global energy supplies.

Brent crude futures climbed $0.92, or 0.9%, to close at $97.92 a barrel, marking the highest close since July 23 for the second consecutive trading day; U.S. West Texas Intermediate (WTI) futures rose $1.55, or 1.7%, to $93.03 a barrel, the highest close since June 4. Both benchmark crudes are now in technically overbought territory.

The Houthis attacked four southern Saudi cities on Tuesday. The kingdom, a key U.S. ally, saw more than 70 people injured and oil facilities set ablaze. Houthi‑controlled media later reported Saudi warplanes conducting air strikes on the Jubah area east of Yemen’s capital Sana’a and on the southwestern Taiz province.

Middle‑East energy supplies have been severely disrupted since the U.S. and Israel jointly struck Iran at the end of February. Iran subsequently attacked regional energy infrastructure and vessels transiting the Hormuz Strait, significantly affecting oil exports from the Persian Gulf.

Saudi Arabia, the world’s second‑largest crude producer after the United States, has been routing oil through the Red Sea and alternative routes to reduce reliance on the Hormuz Strait after its transport was hampered. Tuesday’s attacks appear to be among the largest recent strikes on Saudi Arabia, prompting market fears that a broader conflict could threaten other Middle‑East energy facilities beyond Hormuz and amplify global economic fallout.

Wall Street is now confronting the risk that Middle‑East shipping and energy supply disruptions could persist into 2027. Banks such as Goldman Sachs and HSBC have recently raised their oil price forecasts for the remainder of 2026 and for 2027, reflecting concerns that tight Middle‑East supply conditions may be prolonged.

According to shipping data firm Kpler, the number of cargo vessels passing through the Hormuz Strait fell to seven on Monday, down from eight the day before. Before the U.S. and Israel’s late‑February attacks on Iran, roughly 20% of global oil supplies moved through Hormuz, underscoring the importance of the strait to world energy markets.

Oil prices surged even higher intraday on Tuesday before giving back some gains as inflation and interest‑rate risks rose. Investors worry that continued fuel‑cost increases could stoke global inflation, forcing central banks to keep or raise rates, which would dampen economic growth and energy demand.

Global fuel prices have jumped sharply in recent weeks, driven mainly by supply disruptions at refineries in the Middle East, Russia and other regions. U.S. diesel prices hit historic highs last week, and American consumers faced record gasoline prices over the Labor Day weekend.

Several senior energy executives expect that limited global refining capacity, combined with Russia’s ban on fuel exports after its facilities were repeatedly hit in Ukraine and the approaching northern‑hemisphere winter demand peak, could keep diesel supplies tight throughout the winter season.

Rising fuel costs, comments from Federal Reserve Governor Christopher Waller and a stronger‑than‑expected U.S. jobs report have prompted some investors to revise expectations for U.S. rate policy. CME’s FedWatch Tool shows traders now assign about a 60% probability to a rate hike at the Fed’s Sep 15‑16 meeting, up from roughly 50% before the jobs data.

Developments in the Russia‑Ukraine war also influence oil prices. In a phone call on Tuesday, U.S. President Donald Trump told Russian President Vladimir Putin he hopes the conflict ends quickly so that full U.S.–Russia relations can be restored. The Kremlin said Putin backs Trump’s view.

If the Russia‑Ukraine war ends, Russian energy exports could rise, putting downward pressure on international oil prices. U.S. energy data indicate Russia will be the world’s third‑largest crude producer in 2025, behind the United States and Saudi Arabia, and remains a key OPEC+ member.

In Asia, Chinese customs data released on Tuesday showed August crude imports improved versus July but were still 23.4% lower than a year earlier. China, the world’s second‑largest economy after the United States, has limited refined‑product exports since March to safeguard domestic supply; the export curbs remain in place despite domestic consumption slipping as fuel prices climb.

Markets now face a confluence of Middle‑East supply risks, limited global refining capacity, Russian export uncertainties and slowing Chinese crude demand. Should the Middle‑East conflict spread further into major producers like Saudi Arabia, oil prices could stay supported by supply‑disruption fears; however, high prices also feed inflation, rates and slower global growth, which could curb demand and limit further price gains.

paras_en: Pre‑market Taiwan stock news for September 9.

The Taiwan index closed at 47,105.78 points on the 8th, down 220.49 points, holding above the 47,000‑point threshold with a turnover of NT$876.662 billion. Foreign investors were net buyers for the third consecutive day, buying NT$13.268 billion, adding 93,000 shares of Winbond, 85,000 shares of AU Optronics, and 34,000 shares of Nanya Technology.

ASML (ASML‑US) and TSMC (2330‑TW, TSM‑US) announced on the 8th that TSMC will incorporate ASML's High‑NA EUV technology into its advanced‑process mass production starting in 2030, and will double the size of photomasks from the current 6‑inch to 12‑inch, thereby increasing equipment productivity.

Arm (ARM‑US) announced on the 8th that its Arm Total Design ecosystem will be expanded to cover Physical AI, launching the "Arm Total Design for Physical AI" initiative. More than 80 partners are linked together, including nine Taiwanese manufacturers led by TSMC, covering AI models, software, compute hardware, sensors, virtual platforms and digital twins, to accelerate the move from concept validation to large‑scale deployment of autonomous systems such as robots and self‑driving cars.

Formosa Plastics (1301‑TW) reported August revenue and outlook for the third and fourth quarters of 2026. The company said ongoing Middle‑East conflicts keep crude oil futures high, resulting in Q3 revenue lower than Q2, but September marks China's "golden September, silver October" petrochemical peak season. With higher plant utilization and sales volumes, Formosa expects Q4 performance to exceed Q3. Nanya (1301‑TW) continues to benefit from rapid AI‑hardware innovation, with electronic materials entering a growth phase; it forecasts Q3 and Q4 results to beat Q2 and improve quarter‑by‑quarter.

Distributor Synnex (2450‑TW) held its Q3 earnings briefing on the 8th, stating that the launch of flagship smartphones from Apple and major Android brands in the second half will usher in the traditional consumer‑electronics peak season. Historically, H2 revenue outperforms H1, so the company expects both revenue and profit in the second half to surpass the first half.

Taiwan Cement (1218‑TW) formally appointed Yoli Law Firm on the 8th, with Marketing Vice President Niu An‑ze representing the company at the Taipei District Court to file a civil suit against Zhonglian Oil, Fushou Industrial (1219‑TW), Fumao (1225‑TW) and Nanqiao (1702‑TW), seeking NT$10 billion in damages for losses caused by the Zhonglian oil incident.
Post‑market Taiwan stock wrap: TSMC alone steadied the market; heavyweight stocks faded, the index fell 220 points but held above 47,000.
Foreign investors bought for the third straight day, netting NT$13.2 billion and adding 93,000 shares of Winbond and 85,000 shares of AU Optronics.
TSMC announced it will adopt ASML's High‑NA EUV technology from 2030 and double photomask size.
Arm seizes the Physical AI opportunity, rallying over 80 partners to build a joint robot architecture, with eight Taiwanese manufacturers joining.
Synnex anticipates a second‑half peak season as Apple and Android flagship phones launch, expecting revenue to rise each quarter and beat the first half.
"Golden September, silver October" peak season plus near‑full capacity in electronic‑materials production leads Formosa Plastics and Nanya to expect stronger Q4 performance.
Yageo posted August revenue of NT$16.332 billion, a 50% year‑over‑year increase, setting a new monthly high driven by AI applications and strong Asian demand.
Synnex again highlights the simultaneous launch of Apple and Android flagship phones, projecting a second‑half peak season with quarterly revenue growth surpassing the first half.
The Zhonglian oil incident resurfaces; Taiyuan (Tai‑Shan) files a NT$10 billion claim against Zhonglian, Fushou, Fumao and Nanqiao.
CTBC Bank and Taiwan Life Insurance jointly plan to invest a total of NT$4.1 billion in the upcoming Han‑Test IPO bid.
Taiwan Da‑Lin Morning reports that if the public tender offer for Jing‑Cheng succeeds, the company will target telecom‑leader revenue levels next year.

items.title: 汎瑋8月、前8月營收雙創新高 受惠電子材料應用拓展AI強勁需求
items.title_en: PanWei's August and Year-to-Date Revenues Hit Record Highs, Boosted by Expanding Electronic Materials Applications and Strong AI Demand
paras: 電子機能材料廠汎瑋材料(6967-TW)今(8)日公告8月營收為為13.3億元、月減11.65％、年增1.12％，累計今(2026)年1-8月合併營收達11.05億元，較去年同期大幅成長22.98％。汎瑋表示，延續電子功能性材料在工業電腦及AI伺服器等應用拓展，今年以來強勁的營運成長動能，也帶動8月、前8月合併營收雙雙改寫歷年同期新高。
汎瑋表示，前8月營收主要受惠近年持續深耕高附加價值電子功能性材料解決方案，旗下導電、散熱、電磁屏蔽、絕緣等產品在工業電腦及AI伺服器等終端應用持續拓展，帶動工業電腦及AI伺服器相關產品需求強勁成長，前8月相關終端應用產品營收較去(2025)年同期成長188％。
此外，汎瑋也受惠電動車品牌車廠交車量增加，汽車隔熱紙需求同步提升，亦挹注3M產品經銷業務成長，使電子功能性材料解決方案及經銷業務雙向挹注整體營運，推升前8月營收維持雙位數成長。

汎瑋也觀察到，目前全球AI伺服器需求強勁增長，帶動整體產業鏈進入新一輪升級週期，但同時地緣政治與美國製造政策也正快速改寫全球科技供應鏈版圖，使產業朝向「全球在地化」布局。面對此一趨勢，汎瑋憑「區域供應」的跨國韌性供應網，除了台灣與中國生產基地外，亦持續強化東南亞(越南、馬來西亞)布局，將以靈活的供貨彈性與全球在地化支援能力，成功承接供應鏈轉移帶來的新訂單，主要涵蓋筆記型電腦、智慧家電等應用，預計於今(2026)年第4季末後陸續放量，帶動相關產品出貨與營收貢獻同步提升。
汎瑋表示，隨著客戶持續擴大在亞洲區域的產能配置，公司亦將持續深化全球在地化供應布局，透過多區域生產與供應鏈整合優勢，提升客戶導入意願及長期合作深度，進一步掌握供應鏈移轉所帶來的市場商機。
展望下半年，汎瑋也維持審慎樂觀，除了持續深耕AI伺服器、HPC及智慧家電等既有高階應用市場，汎瑋也將進一步掌握下一波AI硬體升級商機，積極將既有高可靠度、高導熱及EMI防護材料技術延伸至更多新興終端應用，並透過全球在地化供應布局與材料技術整合，加速拓展高附加價值應用市場，優化產品組合與營運結構，以挹注未來整體營運保持穩健成長動能。
paras_en: Electronic functional materials manufacturer PanWei Materials (6967-TW) announced today that August revenue was NT$1.33 billion, down 11.65% month‑over‑month but up 1.12% year‑over‑year. Cumulative consolidated revenue for January‑August 2026 reached NT$11.05 billion, a sharp 22.98% increase from the same period last year. PanWei said that continued expansion of electronic functional materials in industrial computers and AI servers has driven strong operating momentum this year, leading both August and year‑to‑date revenues to set new historical highs for the same months.

PanWei noted that the year‑to‑date revenue benefited from its deepening focus on high‑value‑added electronic functional material solutions. Its conductive, thermal‑management, electromagnetic‑shielding and insulating products have continued to expand in industrial computers and AI servers, spurring robust demand for related products. Revenue from these end‑application segments grew 188% compared with the same period in 2025.

In addition, PanWei gained from the increase in vehicle deliveries by electric‑vehicle brands, which lifted demand for automotive heat‑shield films. This also boosted its 3M product distribution business, allowing both the electronic functional material solutions and distribution channels to feed each other and drive double‑digit year‑to‑date growth.

PanWei observed that global AI‑server demand is rising sharply, pushing the entire supply chain into a new upgrade cycle. At the same time, geopolitical tensions and U.S. manufacturing policies are rapidly reshaping the global tech supply‑chain map, prompting a shift toward “global localization.” To meet this trend, PanWei leverages a resilient, cross‑border supply network – with production bases in Taiwan and China and an expanding footprint in Southeast Asia (Vietnam, Malaysia) – to offer flexible delivery and localized support. It aims to capture new orders from the supply‑chain shift, mainly for notebook computers and smart home appliances, with volumes expected to ramp up after the end of Q4 2026, boosting shipments and revenue contributions.

PanWei said that as customers continue to expand capacity in the Asian region, the company will further deepen its global localized supply layout. By integrating multi‑regional production and supply‑chain advantages, it seeks to increase customer adoption willingness and deepen long‑term cooperation, thereby seizing market opportunities created by supply‑chain transitions.

Looking ahead to the second half of the year, PanWei remains cautiously optimistic. While continuing to deepen its presence in existing high‑end markets such as AI servers, HPC and smart home appliances, the company will also capture the next wave of AI‑hardware upgrade opportunities. It plans to extend its high‑reliability, high‑thermal‑conductivity and EMI‑protection material technologies to more emerging end‑applications, and accelerate growth in high‑value‑added markets through its global localized supply network and material‑technology integration, optimizing its product mix and operating structure to sustain robust growth momentum.

items.title: 中信銀、台壽相繼出手 合計擬砸41億元參與漢測IPO競拍
items.title_en: CTBC Bank and Taiwan Life Successively Move to Bid Up to NT$4.1 Billion in Han Test IPO
paras: 隨著 AI 產業發展，半導體設備廠漢測(7856-TW)近期IPO案掀起市場高度關注，中信金(2891-TW)旗下二大子公司相繼出手，台灣人壽日前核決授權上限20億元參與競拍，中國信託商業銀行今(8)日亦發布公告，經執行長核決通過，擬以自有資金不超過新台幣21億元參與漢測股票競拍，兩家合計投入競拍的資金上限高達 41 億元。
漢民測試系統股份有限公司為國內知名半導體設備與工程服務業者，受惠於AI應用需求強勁帶動整體半導體產業穩健成長，營運前景備受市場關注。漢測預計於9月中旬辦理首次公開發行(IPO)股票競價拍賣，吸引眾多機構法人關注。
根據中信銀行8日發布的公告指出，本次交易標的為漢測普通股，交易決策係依據內部評價及博頌會計師事務所余良元會計師出具之價格合理性意見書進行。中信銀表示，本次投資為依據銀行法相關規定，以銀行自有資金進行財務性投資，參與競拍金額上限為新台幣21億元(不含手續費等)。
在此之前，台灣人壽亦於7日代母公司中信金公告，經內部金融投資總處總處長授權，擬以自有資金上限20億元參與漢測IPO競拍。台灣人壽指出，AI需求崛起帶動半導體市場蓬勃發展，漢測等供應鏈設備廠營運可望持續受惠，因此基於保險資金之長期穩健運用進行布局。
壽險與金融業者近年積極將資金注入半導體及AI相關產業鏈，涵蓋設備服務、封裝測試、散熱等關鍵領域。由於漢測IPO目前尚未開標，中信銀與台灣人壽皆表示，實際取得之股數、每股單位價格與最終交易總金額，均須待正式開標結果確定後再行補充公告。
paras_en: As the AI industry expands, semiconductor equipment maker Han Test (7856‑TW) has drawn strong market interest for its upcoming IPO. CTBC Financial (2891‑TW) sees its two major subsidiaries act in quick succession: Taiwan Life recently approved a NT$20 billion ceiling to join the bid, and China Trust Commercial Bank announced today (the 8th) that, after CEO approval, it intends to use up to NT$21 billion of its own funds to participate, bringing the combined maximum bid amount to NT$41 billion.

Han Min Test Systems Co., Ltd. is a well‑known domestic semiconductor equipment and engineering services provider. Benefiting from robust AI‑driven demand that is bolstering overall semiconductor growth, its operating outlook is attracting market attention. Han Test plans to conduct a book‑building auction for its first‑time public offering in mid‑September, drawing interest from many institutional investors.

According to the announcement released by CTBC Bank on the 8th, the transaction target is Han Test common stock. The investment decision is based on an internal valuation and a price‑reasonableness opinion issued by auditor Yu Liang‑yuan of Boso CPA. CTBC Bank states the investment complies with banking‑law regulations and will be made with its own capital, with a bid ceiling of NT$21 billion (excluding fees).

Earlier, on the 7th, Taiwan Life, on behalf of its parent CTBC Financial, announced that, after authorization from the head of its internal financial investment department, it plans to use up to NT$20 billion of its own funds to join the Han Test IPO bid. Taiwan Life noted that the surge in AI demand is driving vigorous growth in the semiconductor market, and that equipment suppliers like Han Test are likely to continue benefiting, making this a long‑term, stable deployment of insurance capital.

Life insurers and financial firms have recently been actively channeling funds into semiconductor and AI‑related supply chains, covering key areas such as equipment services, packaging and testing, and thermal management. Because the Han Test IPO has not yet been priced, both CTBC Bank and Taiwan Life said the actual number of shares obtained, the per‑share price, and the final transaction amount will be disclosed after the formal auction results are released.

items.title: 主動式ETF正夯，該賣掉0050跳槽嗎？清流君回測打臉：抱超過15年，有8成落後大盤！
paras: 近期台股市場掀起一陣「主動式 ETF」旋風，各大投信紛紛推出標榜「經理人主動選股、汰弱留強、追求超額報酬」的全新商品。看著檔檔吸睛的宣傳文案與短線亮麗的走勢，許多原本堅定持有 0050 等被動市值型 ETF 的投資人，內心不禁開始動搖：
「0050 只會傻傻照市值買，遇到弱勢股也不會砍，是不是落伍了？」
「主動式 ETF 有專業研究團隊操盤，還能靈活避開下市風險，我是不是該把 0050 賣掉，跳槽轉戰主動型商品？」
對於市場上的換股焦慮，長期倡導指數化投資的達人清流君在優分析的《股民想知道》節目中斬釘截鐵地表示：「主動式 ETF 我個人是完全不碰的！因為只要時間拉長，它們的長期績效勢必會落後大盤指數。」
清流君更拿出國際機構研究與台股過去 20 年的本土資料庫回測，用冷靜的數據「打臉」市場熱潮，揭開主動式投資光鮮亮麗背後最殘酷的真相。

一、標普道瓊 SPIVA 報告曝光：短中天期已顯露敗象
很多人以為台灣股市是「散戶多、淺碟型」的市場，主動選股應該很容易打敗大盤。但國際權威機構標普道瓊指數編撰公司（S&P Dow Jones Indices）針對台灣市場長期追蹤的 SPIVA 報告，直接推翻了這個幻想：
專門針對台股大型股的主動型基金進行統計，在過去 5 到 6 年的觀察期間，落後大型指數的比例高達 60% 至 84%！
換言之，即便是由台灣頂尖投信團隊操盤的主動型基金，光是看近 5～6 年的中期成績單，就有六到八成的經理人繳出不如大盤的及格線成績。

二、回測 20 年台股資料庫：拉長到 15 年，逾 8 成打不贏 0050！
為了不讓數據受限於單一週期，清流君親自調閱 TEJ（台灣經濟新報）共同基金資料庫，進行了一場跨越 20 年（涵蓋約 370 檔台股主動基金）的終極回測。

關鍵：必須把「倖存者偏誤」加進去！
清流君特別強調，很多機構的績效統計會「美化」數據，因為他們只看目前還活著的基金。「這就像看見幾家創業成功的富豪，就斷言創業百分之百會發大財一樣荒謬！」
在這項回測中，清流君將過去十幾年間被清算、倒閉、合併、下市的台股基金通通保留在分母中，以各期期末往回推算，與 0050（含息再投入）進行對決：
持有 3 年至 10 年： 主動基金贏過 0050 的機率大約是 50% 左右（一半一半）。這也是為什麼主動式 ETF 剛推出 3～5 年時最容易吸金，因為此時看似還有一半的經理人能跑贏大盤。
拉長至 15 年、20 年： 勝率呈現雪崩式暴跌！能戰勝 0050 的主動基金只剩下 10%～20% 左右。
這項歷史鐵證告訴我們：只要抱得夠久（超過 15 年），有高達 80% 到 90% 的主動型基金都會被 0050 狠狠甩在後頭！

三、散戶最愛犯的致命大忌：「看過去排行榜挑基金」
「那我不買隨便的主動基金，我專挑過去 3 年或 5 年績效排名前 3 名、前 5 名的『神仙經理人』總可以了吧？」
針對投資人這種常見的僥倖心理，清流君引用美國經典研究方法，統計了 2007 年至 2025 年底的真實數據：
將市場上的基金依過去 3 年績效切分為：贏家組（前 10%）、中間組與輸家組（倒數 10%）。
每組以等權重配置持有 3 年（含息再投入），再拿去跟 0050 比較。
回測結果出現了極度諷刺的一幕：
贏家組依然輸給大盤： 過去 3 年績效最強的前 10% 贏家基金，雖然表現優於中間組與輸家組，但累積總績效依舊落後給 0050！
被唾棄的「輸家組」居然沒差多少： 過去被投資人罵到臭頭、績效墊底的輸家組，如果在後續持續持有，長期年化報酬竟然與贏家組非常接近。
清流君警告：看過去績效去挑主動式 ETF，是投資世界中最危險的「後見之明偏誤（Hindsight Bias）」！ 你誤以為自己找到了事前答案，但實際上你只是選中了一個「剛好在過去 3 年押對行情的幸運兒」，而市場的均值回歸很快就會讓超額報酬消失殆盡。

四、主動型 ETF 為何注定難以擊敗大盤？
為什麼主動型基金與主動式 ETF 隨著時間拉長，績效幾乎必然劣化？核心原因有三：
高昂的內扣摩擦成本： 主動型商品通常收取較高的經理費、保管費與換股周轉交易成本，經理人每年還沒開跑，就先落後大盤 1%～2% 的起跑線。
經理人的風格漂移與更換： 神級經理人可能跳槽、退休，或是其擅長的投資風格（如小型成長股）不再受市場青睞。
零和賽局的殘酷現實： 市場上的機構法人越來越多，所有頂尖大腦彼此競爭扣除手續費後，整體主動資金的平均回報在數學上必然低於市場整體指數。

五、什麼樣的人才能買主動式 ETF？
難道主動式 ETF 真的完全一無是處嗎？清流君給出明確界線：
可以買的情境： 除非你深入研究過該經理人團隊超過 10 年以上的完整操盤經歷，並且你具備堅定不移的信念，相信他在未來 10 到 20 年都能持續打破「8成落後」的統計鐵律，那你可以考慮支持。
絕對不要買的情境： 如果你是抱著**「賭一把」、「看最近很紅想賺波段短線」、「把它當個股在追高殺低」**的心態進場，那麼歷史數據證明，你大概率只會成為繳納高額管理費的韭菜。

結論：不要被行銷包裝迷惑，堅守 0050 才是致勝大道
「最好的投資方式，往往也是最無聊的方式。」
看著滿天飛舞的主動式 ETF 廣告與華麗文案，投資人切莫患了 FOMO（害怕錯過）的毛病。回測 20 年的血淋淋數據已經證明：時間是被動指數投資最好的朋友，卻是主動選股最大的敵人。
如果你手頭握著 0050 或 006208，根本不需要費盡心思換股跳槽。繼續無視市場噪音，將資金穩穩地放在市值型大盤 ETF 裡，「無腦 All-in、長期持有、捏緊捏爆」，你就能輕鬆擊敗市場上 80% 以上忙進忙出的主動選股專家！
